searchText: Sorry but this isn't the appropriate place for questions like that. This server is for research and development into the Ethereum protocol itself. ooh Alright all good sorry. Also alternative is EIP-7778 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9802 where refunds still exist (behavior encouragement), but aren't counted towards block gas accounting (resource constraint) e.g. block gas is gross, not net Ahhh right I remember seeing this EIP, but I forgot! Yes this is actually a better proposal because this indeed keeps the benefits of the refunds but also removes the illogical things to reason about (block gas limit is not actual execution limit currently) Oh its an open PR. excerpts.author: ben_a_adams
excerpts.content:
Also alternative is EIP-7778 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9802 where refunds still exist (behavior encouragement), but aren't counted towards block gas accounting (resource constraint)

e.g. block gas is gross, not net

excerpts.author: jochembrouwer
excerpts.content: Ahhh right I remember seeing this EIP, but I forgot! Yes this is actually a better proposal because this indeed keeps the benefits of the refunds but also removes the illogical things to reason about (block gas limit is not actual execution limit currently)

excerpts.content: Oh its an open PR. I'll review it 🙂
